set.body:
Outcome

Produce the final local evidence bundle from a clean admitted checkout.

Acceptance

- Focused mvpa JVM/Scala.js tests pass.
- compileAll and testAll pass without unrelated failure suppression.
- Resample4s, Alder, and Multivar revisions are immutable and rehearsed without accidental sibling fallback.
- git diff check, package or consumer checks, optimized JS, performance, and documentation gates are reported separately.
- Remote CI and publication are not claimed unless independently observed.
set.title: P7.6: run clean-worktree focused, aggregate, and dependency-pin verification
